extra.description:
The DBS Esso Card promises up to 21.6% fuel savings. It consists of a base 18% instant fuel discount and bonus 3.6% fuel savings (min. S$180 nett fuel spend) at Esso kiosks. 
All DBS Esso Cardholders are also auto-enrolled into the Esso Smiles Driver Rewards programme. This entitles you to earn up to 2.4% Smiles Savings (in the form of Smiles Points) in tandem with the above 21.6% fuel savings.
Overall, it's one of the best petrol credit cards to enjoy fuel discounts while earning rewards if you pump petrol frequently with Esso.
